annotations.title: Similar sales or lets as evidence, no estimate

description:
Sales (kind=sale) or asking lets (kind=let) similar to a subject, as
    EVIDENCE: each row has distance_m, age_months, size_ratio, `match_tier`
    and `why_similar`. Give a `uprn`, or a `place` plus what is being compared
    (type, beds or floor_area_m2). `radius_m` at most 2000; at most 20 rows.

    It returns NO adjusted price, NO point estimate and no comparison with an
    automated valuation: each price is that sale's or advert's own. Do NOT
    present them as the subject's value; to value use the valuation tools.
    Lets are asking rents. Charged only when at least one comparable is returned; covered=false or an
    upstream failure is free. Check `identity` on each row.
    Costs 10 credits (10p).

    Every row carries `identity` (unit | building | street | unresolved): anything but `unit` may describe a block,
    so say so and ask which flat. `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry}
    (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: at most 20 rows, nearest first, cut to 8 KB. Postcode districts and Welsh/Scottish authorities return covered=false with the reason.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
